name: Los Angeles Crimes
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The online server for Los Angeles Crimes. Settings, the admin code (type /code in the chat to become admin) and editor maps are in .config/unity3d/MA/LAC.

config.files: {".config/unity3d/MA/LAC/ServerConfig.txt": {"parser": "file", "find": {"starting port=": "starting port={{server.build.default.port}}", "max players=": "max players={{server.build.env.MAX_PLAYERS}}", "map name=": "map name={{server.build.env.MAP}}", "share to community=": "share to community={{server.build.env.SHARE}}"}}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Los Angeles Crimes. Downloads the Linux server build from
# lacrimesonline.com (which publishes no checksums: the archive is checked to
# be whole before anything is replaced). ServerConfig.txt, bans and editor
# maps live in .config/unity3d/MA/LAC and are never touched once they exist.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
base=https://lacrimesonline.com/builds
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "Los Angeles Crimes' server only runs on x86 (amd64) nodes."

list=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$base/" | grep -oE 'LAC_Linux_v[0-9][0-9.]*\.zip' | sed -E 's/^LAC_Linux_v(.*)\.zip$/\1/' | sort -uV) ||
    fail "lacrimesonline.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ -n "$list" ] || fail "lacrimesonline.com lists no Linux server right now. Reinstall to try again later."
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    ver=$(tail -n 1 <<<"$list")
else
    grep -qxF "$want" <<<"$list" || fail "Los Angeles Crimes has no server $want. Set Version to latest, or to one of: $(tr '\n' ' ' <<<"$list")"
    ver=$want
fi
bin="LAC_Linux_v$ver.x86_64"

if [ -x "$bin" ] && [ -d "LAC_Linux_v${ver}_Data" ] && [ -z "$(ls -d LAC_Linux_v*.x86_64 | grep -vxF "$bin")" ]; then
    echo "Los Angeles Crimes $ver is already installed."
else
    build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$build"
    mkdir -p "$build/x"
    trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
    echo "Downloading Los Angeles Crimes $ver"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/lac.zip" "$base/LAC_Linux_v$ver.zip"
    unzip -tq "$build/lac.zip" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "The download isn't a whole zip file. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/lac.zip" -d "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/$bin" ] || fail "The download has no $bin in it."
    # Only one version at a time, so the start command finds the right one.
    rm -rf LAC_Linux_v*.x86_64 LAC_Linux_v*_Data GameAssembly.so UnityPlayer.so
    cp -a "$build/x/." .
    chmod +x "$bin"
fi

cfg=.config/unity3d/MA/LAC
mkdir -p "$cfg/editor"
if [ ! -f "$cfg/ServerConfig.txt" ]; then
    # A random admin code: players type /<code> in the chat to become admin.
    code=$(( (RANDOM << 15 | RANDOM) % 900000 + 100000 ))
    cat > "$cfg/ServerConfig.txt" <<CFG
#Maps (City, Garage, RagdollParty, TrainFacility)
#Maps (ZombieSurvival, NewTerrainRamps, Island, CarSoccer)
#Editor Maps (editor:myMap), from .config/unity3d/MA/LAC/editor/myMap.txt
#make map rotation with ","
#players can get admin by typing "/YOUR-NUM-CODE" in the chat
#lock down will avoids changes in: server option, editor obj sync
#starting port, max players, map name and share to community come from
#the server's settings in the Panel.

(Moderator)
admin code=$code
lock down=true

(Basic)
restart timer=never
max players=16
map name=TrainFacility
starting port=7777

(Server List)
share to community=true
server language=English
server password=none

(Roleplay)
username=HOST
password=0000
CFG
fi
echo "Installed Los Angeles Crimes $ver. The admin code is in $cfg/ServerConfig.txt."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The server version to install, such as 1.9.7, or latest.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players connected at once.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map, or maps to rotate separated by commas: City, Garage, RagdollParty, TrainFacility, ZombieSurvival, NewTerrainRamps, Island, CarSoccer, or editor:<name>.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: List the server in the game's community server list.
